name: ⚽ Soccer Jam
description: The classic Soccer Jam is back! Red vs Blue on a huge pitch. Dribble, charge up power kicks and CURVE the ball, DISARM the ball carrier, use TURBO and SMACK enemies with hard shots. Earn EXP every match and buy upgrades: Stamina, Strength, Agility, Dexterity and Disarm. Mascots guard the goals, long shots give bonus EXP, first to 10 goals wins! Bots fill the teams so you can play right away.
